name: Rizuhble's Victor Cosplay Haze
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-14,400 (levels 1-21). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Smoke Bomb T3, Fixation T3. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Titanic Magazine. Ultimate (Bullet Dance) is available from Extra Health.

items.name: Rapid Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Titanic Magazine completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Titanic Magazine completes 4.8k weapon in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Active Reload
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Titanic Magazine completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Titanic Magazine completes 4.8k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 3 purchases
items.legacy_note: Sell it late for a counter.

items.name: Swift Striker
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Titanic Magazine completes 1,600 souls on. Upgrade of Rapid Rounds (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Titanic Magazine completes 4.8k weapon in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Extended Magazine
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Titanic Magazine completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Titanic Magazine completes 4.8k weapon in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Titanic Magazine
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 18 to 46% weapon damage. Upgrade of Extended Magazine (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.legacy_note: Sell it late for Mercurial Magnum or Spiritual Overflow.

items.name: Extra Health
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Healing Booster, 10400 souls (~10.4 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Fortitude
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Healing Booster, 8000 souls (~8.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Ricochet
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Completes the 6.4k weapon tier (4,800 to 11,200 invested): bonus 46 to 74% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: start farming and dont stop untill u have siphon bullets

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 14,400-28,000 (levels 21-29). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Sleep Dagger T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Sleep Dagger, damage) grows from 87 to 111. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Healing Booster.

items.name: Healing Booster
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Buffs all your lifesteal, smoke T3 included.

items.name: Siphon Bullets
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Completes the 6.4k vitality tier (4,800 to 11,200 invested): bonus 38 to 50 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: farm until this, then start fighting

items.name: Burst Fire
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

items.name: Bullet Lifesteal
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: component_for)

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Smoke Bomb (2 to 3).

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 28,000-52,800 (levels 29-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Bullet Dance T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Sleep Dagger, damage) grows from 111 to 145.

items.name: Lucky Shot
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Smoke Bomb (3 to 4). Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.legacy_note: More smokes, and Smoke Bomb works as a dispel: it clears hexes and burns.

items.name: Vampiric Burst
items.caption: A button, not a passive: 5s of 70% lifesteal, 34% fire rate and a 75% reload on a 30s cooldown, so it is burst recovery inside a committed fight rather than steady sustain. Upgrade of Bullet Lifesteal (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.
items.legacy_note: Pop it with smoke T3 for the big heal.

items.name: Silencer
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Lucky Shot? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Active Reload.
sections.desc: Dying after Lucky Shot? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Active Reload.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Bullet Resilience
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Their gun heroes' bullets add effects: Infernus, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Spellbreaker
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Big spirit hits plus stuns or slows: Seven, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Stuns and silences keep stopping your ult.

items.name: Cursed Relic
items.caption: Silences, disarms and blocks item use on one enemy for 3.25s and strips their non-ultimate buffs, at -25% damage for you and a 55s cooldown: a single-target answer to a buffed carry or engage.
items.legacy_note: THEY HAVE 30 METAL SKINS AHHH. Shut their carry off before the fight.

items.name: Armor Piercer
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Their frontline stacks bullet resist, like Bullet Resilience, and your gun stops doing damage.

items.name: Surge of Power
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 6,400 invested): bonus 19 to 45 spirit power. Imbued on Sleep Dagger: +28 spirit on that ability only, about +61.6 on its damage (2.20x scaling).
items.legacy_note: Buy instead of Burst Fire. On Sleep Dagger.

items.name: Leech
items.caption: The consistent option against anti-heal: 28% bullet lifesteal that is always on and shrinks the effect of enemy healing reduction, against Vampiric Burst's 70% for 5s once per 30s.
items.legacy_note: Buy instead of Vampiric Burst when they buy anti-heal: Toxic Bullets, Healbane, Inhibitor.

items.name: Blood Tribute
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Buy instead of Burst Fire when 2+ of them stun you: Seven, Abrams, Paige, Infernus. Toggle only in fights.

items.name: Phantom Strike
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Buy instead of Silencer when their gun carry hides behind their frontline. Teleport on them, then ult.

sections.label: Luxury purchases
sections.legacy_desc: Game goes 45+ min. Most important first.
sections.desc: Game goes 45+ min. Most important first.

items.name: Frenzy
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: helps with annoying cc slop. Sell Swift Striker for it.

items.name: Crippling Headshot
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
items.legacy_note: shreds + anti-heals whoever you headshot. Sell Burst Fire (or the swap you took instead) for it.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: if u die the game is over get this. Sell Fortitude for it.

items.name: Indomitable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: i love cc. Sell Healing Tempo for it.

items.name: Mercurial Magnum
items.caption: Imbued on Sleep Dagger: the imbue charges up over 14s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 22% fire rate for 12s.
items.legacy_note: anti metal skin. u can sell Titanic Magazine for this

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: anti metal skin, instead of Mercurial Magnum. Sell Titanic Magazine for it.

items.name: Inhibitor
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Their carry heals a lot or out-damages you. Sell Silencer (or Phantom Strike) for it.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: Sell Counterspell for it if you bought it, otherwise Rapid Recharge.

sections.label: Losing lane (temporary)
sections.legacy_desc: Get Ricochet before Fortitude, then carry on.
sections.desc: Get Ricochet before Fortitude, then carry on.
